template: In Odoo Sales there is currently an UNSAVED draft quotation form open (breadcrumb '{{v1}}', customer '{{v2}}', one line '{{v4}}' qty 1 price {{v5}}). Discard that unsaved draft (use the Discard action or navigate away, do NOT save it). Then create a NEW quotation from scratch: customer '{{v2}}' selected from the customer autocomplete dropdown (an option must actually be clicked). Add exactly ONE order line with a SIMPLE product that does NOT have variants and does NOT trigger the 'Configure your product' configurator dialog — for example a service product or a plain product like '{{v6}} Bloc Screens', 'Cabinet with Doors', 'Large Cabinet', 'Product Test' or similar non-configurable item. Pick it from the product autocomplete dropdown (an option must actually be clicked). Set the line quantity to 3. Then SAVE the quotation. Report: (a) the product name chosen, (b) the unit price the app filled in on the line, (c) the Untaxed Amount shown in the totals, (d) the quotation reference/name (e.g. S00042) shown after saving. Do not confirm the quotation.
